body:
Basically this was a big waste of time.  I do suffer from ADD and have never gotten a prescription so I was curious as to what it would do to me.
I got some from my brother one day. I took the time release capsule off of the Concerta and took it.  Later after not feeling any affects I took the Ritalin.  I layed down waiting for the affects to take place.  I did have a feeling of a slight buzz that lasted for all of 30 seconds.  I waited longer and eventually got bored and started playing MSN Hearts a game I can't normally stand.  I played that game for 5 hours straight, with my eyes fixated on the screen.  I was supposed to go out that night but my friends could hardly take me away from the game.  Fortunally... for me at least we didn't end up going so I continued with my game, for another hour till I was forced to get out of their living room.  Also what was strange this whole time I couldn't stop licking my bottom lip, which is a habit I don't have ever.  I couldn't stop even after I was given some lip balm, even after some conscious effort I couldn't stop.  Going on with the story I finally left the living room(after being forced out)  I went to the bedroom and sat there playing a video game for an hour, when suddenly I felt nauseated.  I ran to the bathroom and puked up so much.  I felt better but continued to play the game.  I finally tried to go to sleep.  I couldn't sleep for anything.  I tried everything counting sheep, telling myself I was sleep but I just couldn't.  I did eventually get a half hour of sleep at about 4 a.m. but soon woke up for no reason and couldn't get back to sleep.  I was okay the next day and was able to go to sleep that next night.
